_howto: Special lesson videos: upload each as a YouTube Short, then add an entry. youtubeId is the id in youtube.com/shorts/<id>. place = a curriculum place id (arrival, cafe, station, konbini, shrine, ramen, castle) or null. goals = which learner goals it suits (travel, anime, friends, work, culture; empty = everyone). checkpoints pause the Short at `at` seconds and show a card: kind 'phrase' (phraseId from the curriculum, skill reading|listening|writing|speaking) or 'word' (entryId from vocab.json). Set enabled to true when the video is live.
